title: Above their own department average
statementMd:
List employees who earn more than the average salary of their own department. Show first name, department id and salary.

Expected columns: `first_name`, `department_id`, `salary`.

Tables: `employees`, `departments`.

Row order does not matter.
hints: Compare with a correlated `(SELECT AVG(...) WHERE department_id = e.department_id)`.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT e.first_name, e.department_id, e.salary FROM employees e WHERE e.salary > (SELECT AVG(e2.salary) FROM employees e2 WHERE e2.department_id = e.department_id);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
